lines: Evening, traveller. Mind the roots — the path is longer than it looks.
My name is Anton. I build things for the web, from the database up to the last pixel.
These days it's TypeScript, Node and React — and a habit of seeing work through to production.
The tavern is just ahead. My notice is pinned up inside.
